name: News Ticker
description: Compact headline ticker that slides through news links one line at a time, with a circular progress ring and megaphone icon counting down to each change.
contents: Vertical list of headline links with optional HTML markup
Circular progress ring with a megaphone icon
behavior: Ring stroke fills over the duration, then the list slides up to the next headline
Loops seamlessly by repeating the first headline at the end and resetting
Headlines clamp to the configured number of lines
editableByProps: Display time per headline, line clamp, color and widths
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Headline text is injected as HTML, so items must be trusted content
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
